title: Tariff Note: Crestline Companion Trip Reinstatement Fee
content:
**Clause.** Under Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, a voluntary reinstatement carries the product's reinstatement fee, charged once. The product's reinstatement fee is the figure published for the product the trip was returned to.

## Quantities of this tariff

- **Value refunded on the cancelled booking** — the most recent taxes-and-fees refund on the ledger of the certificate or pass, plus the most recent companion fare refund and the most recent Hawaii surcharge refund, each of these two counted only when it was recorded on the same entry date as that taxes-and-fees refund; the total is rounded half up to the cent. A refund that is absent counts as zero.
- **Adjusted fee** — the fee multiplied by the booking-time factor and then by one minus the relief percentage, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Reinstatement fee** — the adjusted fee less the credits on the fee, subtracted together, never below zero, rounded half up to the cent.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

| Step | Value |
|---|---|
| Product's reinstatement fee | 50.00 USD |
| Fee charged once | 50.00 USD |
| Reinstatement fee | 50.00 USD |

| Value refunded on the cancelled booking (hypothetical entries) | Counted |
|---|---|
| Taxes-and-fees refund 18.40, recorded 12 May | 18.40 |
| Companion fare refund 119.00, recorded 12 May | 119.00 |
| Hawaii surcharge refund 60.00, recorded 9 May | not counted (different entry date) |
| Value refunded on the cancelled booking | 137.40 |

**Rounding.** Every rounding in this rule is half up to the cent, a value lying exactly on a half cent going up to the next cent.
